messages:
Mae G: Quick kickoff for launch SEO + webinar plumbing. Need an execution list with owners: keyword targets, JSON-LD, sitemap + canonical, redirects, internal linking, and webinar form routing. Who picks up what?

Santiago: I'll own the keyword map and content cluster labels. initial targets: "inference at scale", "LLM serving SLA", "inference cost optimization". will mark primary/secondary/LSI and suggested H1/H2s in the sheet.

Olivia: I'll take structured data and OG. plan: JSON-LD for Product + FAQ + Event (webinar). JSON-LD only (no microdata) so the CMS partial can inject cleanly.

Rosalind: Redirects + sitemap fixes on me. crawling now to get canonical candidates. prefer 301 for permanently moved pages, 302 for temporary/experiments. will provide an old->new CSV with status_code column. example nginx snippet for a moved doc: 
```
# permanent move (301)
location = /docs/old-deploy {
  return 301 https://www.redwood.inference/docs/deployments;
}
```
I'll also include a rule example for path-preserve redirects.

Julian: Internal linking strategy: three pillar pages (product, dedicated, optimize). cluster pages should link up to pillars with descriptive anchor text. I'll produce a CSV: source_page, target_page, anchor_text, reason. sample row: `/blog/gpu-benchmarks,/docs/dedicated-capacity,Redwood Dedicated - reserved GPU pools`

Mae G: Webinar form routing: we need hidden fields for product_interest and utm_campaign, and GTM event for Sales queue routing. @Rosalind can you wire GTM to populate SFDC fields? Also make sure the thank-you flow includes segmenting by interest so SDRs get the right queue.

Rosalind: Yep. GTM will push a dataLayer event `webinarSubmit` with `product_interest` and `utm`. mapping will be in the GTM container. sample snippet I'll add to the doc: 
```html
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"product_interest\" value=\"dedicated\"> 
<script>dataLayer.push({event:'webinarSubmit', product_interest:'dedicated'})</script>
```

Santiago: For content, prioritize quick wins: top-10 pages first for meta updates. I'll flag pages that need new intro paragraphs (200-300 words) to match the keyword intent.

Olivia: Event JSON-LD draft for the webinar (to be added to the webinar page head):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch Webinar","startDate":"2025-05-12T16:00:00Z","url":"https://www.redwood.inference/webinar-launch","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://www.redwood.inference/webinar-launch/register","price":"0"}}
```
I'll add FAQ structured data for the top questions and OG tags for previewing in socials.

Mae G: Sitemap/canonical: I'll open a PR that updates canonical headers for moved pages and regenerates sitemap.xml. We should block the deploy until redirects + canonical are in place.

Rosalind: Crawl report from seo-bot shows: 19 404s, 8 duplicate H1s, 14 missing meta descriptions. I'll attach the CSV and start the redirects list.

seo-bot: Crawl summary uploaded: /drive/seo/launch-2025/crawl-summary.csv. 243 pages scanned. 19 404s, 14 missing descriptions, 7 indexable pages missing canonical.

Julian: One more internal linking note: add product CTAs into top-of-funnel blog posts but mark them as contextual so editorial flow remains natural. I'll supply anchor text variants to avoid repetition.

Mae G: Owners recap: Keywords & content clusters = Santiago; JSON-LD & OG = Olivia; Redirects + GTM wiring = Rosalind; Internal link map & CTAs = Julian; Sitemap/PR + canonical update = Mae. Content drafts assigned by Santiago to content ops.

Olivia: ETA: schema + OG by EOD Wed.

Santiago: ETA: keyword sheet by Wed night, prioritization list of top-10 pages included.

Rosalind: ETA: redirects CSV by Thu morning, GTM mapping doc after that.

Julian: Link map skeleton up by Thu EOD.

Mae G: We'll review everything Fri 10am and merge the sitemap/canonical PR afterward. If engineering is needed for form routing CORS or auth, I'll escalate. Thanks all :thumbsup:
